subject: english
question: **Choose the sentence with no spelling error.**

options.text: Marinate your proteins ahead of time.
Marinate your proteins aheade of time.
Marinatte your proteins ahead of time.
Marinate your protiens ahead of time.

solution:
The correct sentence with no spelling error is: **Option 1:** **"Marinate your proteins ahead of time."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The grammatical rule involved in this sentence is the correct spelling of words.
 
• The word **"marinate"** is spelled correctly, as well as **"proteins"** and **"ahead."**
 
• **Option 2, "Marinate your proteins aheade of time,"** has a spelling error in the word "ahead."
 
• **Option 3, "Marinatte your proteins ahead of time," **has a spelling error in the word "marinate."
 
• **Option 4, "Marinate your protiens ahead of time," **has a spelling error in the word "proteins."
 
• In conclusion, the correct sentence is** option 1: "Marinate your proteins ahead of time."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Marinate **- (of food) undergo marination; soak (meat, fish, or other food) in a marinade.
 
• **Protein **- any of a class of nitrogenous organic compounds that have large molecules composed of one or more long chains of amino acids and are an essential part of all living organisms, especially as structural components of body tissues such as muscle, hair, etc., and as enzymes and antibodies.
 
• **Ahead **- further forward in space; in the line of one's forward motion.
